menu.sendUsage: Send Usage Statistics and Error Reports

telemetry.question: Send anonymous usage statistics and error reports?
telemetry.detail: They help fix crashes and show which features are used: events such as "G-code exported" and error messages, never your files, projects or anything that identifies you. You can change this in the Help menu.

unsaved.title: {what, select, updates {Your update choice couldn't be saved} telemetry {Your choice about usage statistics couldn't be saved} other {Your language choice couldn't be saved}}

updates.question: Check for new versions when Furrow CAM starts?
updates.detail: Furrow CAM will ask GitHub for its list of releases. Nothing about you or your projects is sent. You can change this in the Help menu.

toolpath.pathsTooSmall: The closed paths are too small for the tool.

toolpath.peelIsland: Peel from the island needs exactly one island.

toolpath.modelMissing: The model to machine is missing.
toolpath.noArea: The model has no area seen from above to machine.
toolpath.belowStock: The model reaches below the stock: it is cut no deeper than the stock's bottom.
toolpath.coarsened: The model is too large to machine at full resolution with this tool: it is cut with cells of {size, number} mm instead of {wanted, number} mm.
toolpath.restCoarsened: The area is too large to simulate the stock left at full resolution: it is simulated with cells of {size, number} mm, so material narrower than {width, number} mm the operations before left may be cut at full depth.
toolpath.roughNothing: The stock to leave covers the whole model: there is nothing to rough out.
toolpath.roughMarginOffStock: The margin around the model isn't on the stock: there is nothing to rough out.
